steps.author: maya
steps.say: @noodle pull the overnight activity from checkout, billing and alerts. correlate it with the Sentry spike, but keep this read-only

focus.label: Shared request
focus.note: Work starts in the shared conversation, where everyone can see the request and its constraints.

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: Daily scan: the Sentry spike began 11 minutes after yesterday's billing deploy. Checkout is stable. In billing, invoice-render and PDF export disagree on multi-currency line totals. I have not changed anything.

focus.label: Shared evidence
focus.note: Noodle reports its investigation where both founders can see it.

steps.prompt: Both founders now have the same evidence. Nobody needs to relay an agent summary.

focus.label: Shared evidence
focus.note: Both founders now have the same evidence. Nobody needs to relay an agent summary.

steps.author: tom
steps.say: @hermes inspect the billing path and profile the likely cause. Read only.

focus.label: Two agents
focus.note: Tom brings his independently owned agent into the same investigation.

steps.author: hermes
steps.say: The two surfaces round at different stages: invoice-render rounds converted line items, while PDF export rounds only the final sum. @noodle your deploy correlation fits that path. I would centralize the customer-facing total calculation.

focus.label: Shared reasoning
focus.note: Hermes reasons from evidence Noodle already placed in the room.

steps.author: maya
steps.say: @noodle riff on @hermes's diagnosis. combine it with the activity evidence and propose one plan we can both review

focus.label: Build on it
focus.note: Maya asks one agent to build on another agent's visible result without copying it into a new prompt.

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: Building on @hermes's trace: the smallest fix is one shared customer-facing totals helper used by invoice-render and PDF export. The deploy evidence and code path now point to the same change.

focus.label: Combined diagnosis
focus.note: Noodle combines both investigations into one proposed approach.

focus.label: One Plan
focus.note: Both agents' findings are now one Plan the founders can review together.

steps.prompt: Two independently owned agents have contributed to one shared Plan.

focus.label: One shared Plan
focus.note: Two independently owned agents have contributed to one shared Plan.

steps.author: tom
steps.say: Before we accept this: @hermes check the reconciliation path. What would operations refuse to let this change break?

focus.label: Constraint check
focus.note: Tom asks the person and agent closest to operations what the Plan must preserve.

steps.author: hermes
steps.say: @noodle keep ledger-sync.ts byte-for-byte unchanged. Historical Stripe reconciliation depends on its existing per-line amounts even though the customer-facing calculation needs fixing.

focus.label: New constraint
focus.note: Hermes supplies context that changes the safe implementation scope.

steps.constraint: ledger-sync.ts output must remain identical to existing Stripe charges; do not change it

focus.label: Changed before execution
focus.note: The new constraint changed the Plan before implementation, not during review.

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: Good constraint, @hermes. The Plan now limits the change to invoice-render and PDF export and requires the ledger fixture to stay identical.

focus.label: Plan updated
focus.note: Noodle acknowledges how the shared constraint changed its approach.

steps.prompt: Review the changed Plan, then accept it when the approach is correct.

focus.label: Your decision
focus.note: This is a real human decision. The walkthrough will not accept the Plan for you.

focus.label: Accepted Plan
focus.note: The accepted Plan now carries the shared decision into the next unit of work.

focus.label: Bounded authority
focus.note: The Ticket defines the owner, resource, allowed change, preserved behavior, and verification target.

steps.prompt: The Plan established agreement. The Ticket defines responsibility and authority.

focus.label: Authorize work
focus.note: The Plan established agreement. The Ticket defines responsibility and authority.

steps.prompt: Approve one owner, one bounded scope, and explicit verification.

focus.label: Your decision
focus.note: Approve one owner, one bounded scope, and explicit verification—not an open-ended agent run.

focus.label: Reviewable result
focus.note: The result returns to the same conversation with changed files, preserved behavior, and verification evidence.

steps.prompt: The outcome is reviewable without reconstructing it from logs or copied summaries.

focus.label: Reviewable result
focus.note: The outcome is reviewable without reconstructing it from logs or copied summaries.

steps.author: maya
steps.say: That whole loop stayed here: shared evidence, both agents' ideas, our decision, one authorized implementation, and the proof.

focus.label: One thread
focus.note: The request, agent findings, human decisions, implementation, and proof all remain in one thread.
